newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIAN LEU CLOSES STATIC VS DLR.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIAN LEU CLOSES STATIC VS DLR.

text.p: 1500 GMT - Romania's leu ended Tuesday clinging to 3,660/3,700 to the dollar on an interbank market still hit by hard currency shortages, traders said.
* Operators said they expected some cash injections on the interbank market to come from big exporters who needed lei to make year-end payments or pay wages and bonuses ahead of the winter holidays.
* Leu-dollar retail prices lingered at about 4,750-4,800.
* Money market saw lively trading with banks chasing leu funds at midday. One-week funds traded from 46 to 49 percent. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
